title: Tech Bounces From Selloff: SPCX Earnings Preview & Breakout Watch
speaker: Drew Dosek

macro_themes.view: Unresolved Middle East conflict and hot CPI/PPI keep yields rising; expects one more Fed hike by year-end.
Earnings season is underway; any crack in guidance will be punished given higher yields.
Expects Middle East conflict to escalate after the midterms, lifting oil.

calls.condition: Daily closes below 7640.4 / 7600.4 send price back to the top of the channel near 7484.2
calls.reason: Repeatedly testing prior ATH pivot and rising trend line support; the more it knocks, the likelier they give way.
calls.quote: the more and more we keep knocking on both of these levels of support... they're likely to give way

calls.reason: Confirmed breakdown of the March trend line; bounces likely rejected at the retest - breakdown, retrace, fade.
calls.quote: any sort of bounces on the NASDAQ are not only going to get jammed up by this declining trend line

calls.condition: Would rather see it sell straight into 512 then go long for a bounce
calls.reason: Semis closed at lows; 512.36 stacks the 50% fib, 200-day MA and trend line as support.
calls.quote: we're likely still going to see some selling pressure in the coming days, pushing price lower

calls.condition: Expects consolidation between 5.021 and 5.289 for weeks, then a breakout
calls.reason: Unresolved Middle East conflicts and a likely rate hike; rising parallel channel targets 5.77%.
calls.quote: before we eventually break out and go higher on the 10-year yield

calls.condition: If the bear flag keeps playing out
calls.reason: Gold is in a bearish consolidation; buy zone is 3639 to 3500 at the trend line and prior ATH pivot.
calls.quote: That's the buy zone that I have on gold should this bare flag continue playing out, pushing price down.

calls.condition: If it keeps consolidating sideways it heads to 59; buyer at 53-50 on further selling
calls.reason: Head-and-shoulders target 53-50 is the buy area; a decades-long rising channel supports holding for life.
calls.quote: My time horizon on silver is a very long time.

calls.condition: Bulls need a move to 85,000 for upside momentum
calls.reason: Near-term bear flag, but holding support at 80,524 so the chart is not damaged.
calls.quote: right now. Near-term bare flag pattern.

calls.reason: Inverse head-and-shoulders measures to 116; expects Middle East escalation after the midterms, with a stall near 103 first.
calls.quote: the chart still telling me 116 is where US oil is going to be going

calls.condition: Expects a bounce if price falls to 3.21
calls.reason: Breakout from the declining trend line holds but has not been retraced; target 3.89.
calls.quote: I do still see the targeted move up here at $3.89 being accomplished

calls.condition: If tomorrow closes above today's candle the breakout has more staying power
calls.reason: Sixth close back inside the top half of its long-term channel; keeps knocking on the door.
calls.quote: eventually a door is going to open for you and price will go up higher

calls.reason: Oversold on the daily at a long-term trend line, due for a technical bounce; would add near 69.65.
calls.quote: due for a technical bounce that could take us back up to test the $100 mark

calls.condition: Bulls need back above 322.52; on selling, buy 281-285 for a bounce to 296
calls.reason: Near-term breakdown below the rising trend line into earnings; bottom of the channel near 285.87.
calls.quote: I would be a buyer of GE down here at the bottom of the parallel right around 281 to 285

calls.condition: Daily closes above 149.34 send it back to the trend line near 162.81
calls.reason: Bounced off the 50% fib with strong wicks; expects a near-term bounce, though earnings are a coin flip.
calls.quote: I'm anticipating a near-term bounce on the chart there of SpaceX.
